1ubi.pdb.citation: Alexeev D, Bury SM, Turner MA, Ogunjobi OM, Muir TW, Ramage R, Sawyer L. Synthetic, structural and biological studies of the ubiquitin system: the total chemical synthesis of ubiquitin. Biochem J. 1994;299:151-158. PMID 8166633.
1ubi.pdb.uniprotMapping: DBREF 1UBI A 1-76 -> UniProt P62988 (UBIQ_HUMAN) 1-76, as recorded in the file. P62988 is a legacy accession; human ubiquitin is encoded by UBB, UBC, UBA52 and RPS27A with an identical mature 76-residue sequence.
1ubi.pdb.obtainedFrom: ProDy source distribution test data (prody sdist on PyPI, tests/datafiles/pdb1ubi.pdb), MIT-licensed package; the PDB entry itself is distributed by wwPDB under CC0 1.0.
1ubi.pdb.verification: Header, DBREF, SEQRES, HELIX/SHEET and coordinates read from the file. NOT re-verified byte-for-byte against files.rcsb.org because RCSB and UniProt are blocked by this environment's network policy.
1ubi.pdb.notes: Synthetic (chemically synthesised) human ubiquitin made from L-amino acids; 81 HETATM records are waters.
